title: Sega Ages: Memorial Selection Vol. 2
native_title: セガエイジス メモリアル・セレクションＶＯＬ．２
overview:
The second volume of Memorial Selection. Six classic games included!

Six Sega games from the 1980s, collected on one disc:

- Samurai - switch between high, middle and low sword stances to cut down evil in this period action game
- Monaco GP - a high-speed racing game
- Star Jacker - a shooter where you fly in formation with up to four allied ships and attack targets in the air and on the ground
- Sindbad Mystery - grab the "?" to open panels and reveal the map, then use quick fingers and a sharp mind to find the treasure
- Doki Doki Penguin Land - guide a cute penguin as he carries an egg to his sweetheart's room without breaking it
- Ninja Princess - a princess uses throwing stars and vanishing ninja arts to defeat enemies and retake Kanten Castle across 16 stages

For 1 or 2 players, with Arcade Racer support and memory backup.

メモリアルセレクション第2弾。名作ゲーム6本を収録！
